level.why: 三人對話先敲定上午吊掛、再因風速限制改到下午，並需理解同意語句的意圖。

dialogue.t: We should lift the steel beams to the fourth floor first thing tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該明天一早就把鋼樑吊到四樓。

dialogue.t: That works for me. The crane is ready, and my team can start at seven.
dialogue.zh: 我可以。起重機已準備好，我的團隊七點就能開始。

dialogue.t: Before we confirm, I looked at the wind report. Gusts could reach forty kilometers per hour in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 在確認之前，我看了風況報告。早上的陣風可能達到每小時四十公里。

dialogue.t: Is that too strong for lifting?
dialogue.zh: 那樣對吊掛來說太強了嗎？

dialogue.t: Our safety rule says we stop lifting above thirty-five.
dialogue.zh: 我們的安全規定是超過三十五就要停止吊掛。

dialogue.t: She's right. Swinging a heavy beam in strong gusts is dangerous.
dialogue.zh: 她說得對。在強陣風中擺動沉重的鋼樑很危險。

dialogue.t: Then what about the afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 那下午呢？

dialogue.t: The wind drops after one o'clock, so the afternoon should be safe.
dialogue.zh: 風在一點後會減弱，所以下午應該是安全的。

dialogue.t: Fine, we'll lift after lunch. In the morning, the workers can cut and sort the beams on the ground.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們午餐後再吊。早上工人可以在地面切割並分類鋼樑。

dialogue.t: Good idea. That way we won't waste the morning.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。這樣我們就不會浪費早上的時間。

dialogue.t: I'll inspect the crane cables at noon, so everything is ready by one.
dialogue.zh: 我中午會檢查起重機的鋼索，這樣一點前一切都會就緒。

dialogue.t: Perfect. I'll update the daily plan and send it out tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我今晚會更新每日計畫並發出去。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Rescheduling a lifting job because of the wind
choices.zh: 因風勢而重新安排吊掛作業
choices.why: 原定早上吊掛，因陣風過強改到下午。

choices.t: Buying a new crane
choices.why: 起重機已準備好，沒有提到購買。

choices.t: Repairing damaged steel beams
choices.why: 鋼樑是吊掛的對象，沒有說受損。

choices.t: Training new workers
choices.why: 對話沒有提到訓練。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "She's right"?
q.zh: 男子說「She's right」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He agrees that strong wind is a safety risk.
choices.zh: 他同意強風是安全風險。
choices.why: 他接著說強陣風中擺動鋼樑很危險。

choices.t: He prefers to start earlier.
choices.why: 他支持督導的看法，不提早吊掛。

choices.t: He thinks the crane is broken.
choices.why: 他一開始說起重機已準備好。

choices.t: He wants to cancel the project.
choices.why: 對話只是改到下午，並非取消。

q.t: What will the workers do in the morning?

choices.t: Prepare the beams on the ground
choices.why: 經理說早上工人可以在地面切割並分類鋼樑。

choices.t: Lift the beams to the fourth floor
choices.why: 吊掛已改到下午。

choices.t: Inspect the crane cables
choices.why: 是安全督導中午去檢查，不是工人。

choices.t: Update the daily plan
choices.why: 是經理今晚更新計畫。

level.why: 三人對話先考慮離門最近的區域、後因溫度與重量改選，並需結合圖表與三項條件判斷。

dialogue.t: The new paint order arrives tomorrow, and it weighs about six hundred kilograms in total.
dialogue.zh: 新的油漆訂單明天會到，總重大約六百公斤。

dialogue.t: Zone A is closest to the loading door, and it has forty open racks.
dialogue.zh: A 區離裝卸門最近，而且有四十個空貨架。

dialogue.t: But Zone A gets hot. The label says to keep the paint between ten and twenty-five degrees.
dialogue.zh: 但 A 區會變熱。標籤上說油漆要保存在十到二十五度之間。

dialogue.t: I forgot about that. We can't use Zone A, then.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了這點。那就不能用 A 區了。

dialogue.t: What about Zone D? It has plenty of space.
dialogue.zh: 那 D 區呢？它有很多空間。

dialogue.t: That's too cold. At five degrees, the paint could be damaged.
dialogue.zh: 那太冷了。在五度時，油漆可能會受損。

dialogue.t: Then we need the right temperature and a rack that holds all six hundred kilograms.
dialogue.zh: 那我們需要合適的溫度，以及能承重全部六百公斤的貨架。

dialogue.t: I want everything on a single rack, so it can be moved in one trip.
dialogue.zh: 我希望所有東西放在同一個貨架上，這樣一趟就能搬完。

dialogue.t: Then there's only one zone that fits all three conditions.
dialogue.zh: 那麼只有一個區域符合這三項條件。

dialogue.t: Agreed. I'll mark the rack tomorrow morning before the truck arrives.
dialogue.zh: 同意。明天早上貨車到之前，我會標記好那個貨架。

dialogue.t: And I'll print the location labels this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 我今天下午會把位置標籤印出來。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "I forgot about that"?
q.zh: 男子說「I forgot about that」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He had overlooked the heat problem in Zone A.
choices.zh: 他先前忽略了 A 區的高溫問題。
choices.why: 他隨後說因此不能用 A 區。

choices.t: He disagrees with the paint label.
choices.why: 他接受標籤的溫度規定。

choices.t: He forgot when the order arrives.
choices.why: 對話沒有顯示他忘了到貨時間。

choices.t: He wants to use Zone D instead.
choices.why: 是女士提出 D 區，且被否決。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Where will the paint most likely be stored?
q.zh: 請看圖表。油漆最可能存放在哪裡？

choices.t: Zone C
choices.why: 20°C 在 10–25 度之間，單一貨架可承重 900 公斤，足以放 600 公斤。

choices.t: Zone A
choices.why: 35°C 超過油漆需要的 10–25 度。

choices.t: Zone B
choices.why: 溫度合適，但貨架只能承重 500 公斤，不夠 600 公斤。

choices.t: Zone D
choices.why: D 區只有 5°C，太冷，已被否決。

q.t: What does the man say he will do tomorrow morning?
q.zh: 男子說他明天早上會做什麼？

choices.t: Mark the rack before the truck arrives
choices.zh: 在貨車到之前標記貨架
choices.why: 他說明天早上貨車到之前會標記貨架。

choices.t: Print the location labels
choices.why: 是女士今天下午要印標籤。

choices.t: Move the paint to Zone D
choices.zh: 把油漆搬到 D 區
choices.why: D 區太冷，已被否決。

choices.t: Call the paint supplier
choices.why: 對話沒有提到打電話給供應商。

level.why: 三人對話先要求換貨、因生產期太長改為挪用並取得補償，需理解意圖與因果。

dialogue.t: The tiles arrived this morning, but they're gray, and we ordered white ones.
dialogue.zh: 磁磚今天早上到了，但它們是灰色的，我們訂的是白色。

dialogue.t: I'm sorry about that. Our order sheet shows the wrong color code was entered on our side.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。我們的訂單表顯示是我們這邊輸入了錯誤的顏色代碼。

dialogue.t: We need the white tiles by Friday for the lobby floor. Can you swap them quickly?
dialogue.zh: 我們週五前需要白色磁磚來鋪大廳地板。你可以很快換貨嗎？

dialogue.t: I can send the white ones, but the factory needs ten days to make that many.
dialogue.zh: 我可以送白色的，但工廠要十天才能做出那麼多。

dialogue.t: Ten days is too long. The lobby inspection is next week.
dialogue.zh: 十天太久了。大廳的驗收在下週。

dialogue.t: Then returning them makes no sense. Could we use the gray tiles in the back hallway instead?
dialogue.zh: 那退回去就沒意義了。我們能把灰色磁磚改用在後面的走廊嗎？

dialogue.t: That works. The hallway needs about half the amount.
dialogue.zh: 可以。走廊大約只需要一半的量。

dialogue.t: In that case, I can give you a twenty percent credit on the gray tiles for the mistake.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話，為這次的錯誤，我可以給你們灰色磁磚八折的補償。

dialogue.t: That's fair. If any white tiles are in stock, please send them for the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 這很合理。如果有白色磁磚的現貨，請送來給大廳用。

dialogue.t: I'll check our other storage center and call you back within the hour.
dialogue.zh: 我會查一下我們其他的倉儲中心，一小時內回電給你們。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Please call me directly, since I manage the lobby schedule.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請直接打給我，因為我負責大廳的工程時程。

choices.t: Tiles of the wrong color were sent.
choices.zh: 送來了顏色錯誤的磁磚。
choices.why: 他們訂白色，收到灰色。

choices.t: The tiles were broken in transit.
choices.why: 沒有提到破損。

choices.t: The tiles arrived a week late.
choices.why: 磁磚是今天早上到，一週是驗收的時間。

choices.t: The invoice amount is incorrect.
choices.why: 問題是顏色，不是金額。

q.t: Why can't the supplier replace the tiles quickly?
q.zh: 供應商為什麼無法很快換貨？

choices.t: The factory needs ten days to make them.
choices.why: 男子說工廠要十天才能做出那麼多。

choices.t: The supplier has no order sheet.
choices.why: 他查看了訂單表。

choices.t: The customer entered the wrong code.
choices.zh: 是客戶輸入了錯誤代碼。
choices.why: 男子說錯誤出在供應商這邊。

choices.t: Friday is a holiday.
choices.why: 對話沒有提到假日。

q.t: What does the woman mean when she says, "Then returning them makes no sense"?
q.zh: 女士說「Then returning them makes no sense」是什麼意思？

choices.t: Sending the gray tiles back would not solve the problem.
choices.zh: 把灰色磁磚退回去無法解決問題。
choices.why: 換貨要十天，趕不上驗收，所以她改提挪用。

choices.t: She wants her money back immediately.
choices.why: 她反而提出保留並使用灰色磁磚。

choices.t: She likes the gray color.
choices.why: 她只是找實際可行的使用方式。

choices.t: She is angry at the supplier.
choices.why: 她語氣務實，且接受補償。
